about: Analyst labels of every parsed market figure (sizes, forecasts, growth rates) and price point in the live benchmark runs of 2026-10-21, judged by reading each excerpt (qualitative, not a gate). A figure is correct when its value, currency, kind, year and scope (geography, segment, measure, market definition) are what the excerpt says. Labelled by the implementing agent (Claude), not an independent reviewer.

run1.code: ae25ee5 (M7 scope fix, before benchmark findings)
